result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but several elements are clipped or incomplete: the second 'Popular right now' card is missing its title/metadata, a horizontally scrolled card's name is hard-truncated, and the bottom navigation bar shows a stray black bar overlapping its icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar has a long black horizontal bar/line running across it, overlapping and obscuring the middle (search) and third (bookmark/orders) icons. Labels are also missing and the icons appear misaligned/greyed.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar element (likely a misplaced divider or gesture-indicator), align the tab icons evenly, and add text labels with consistent active/inactive styling.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza image) has no restaurant name, rating, delivery time, or cuisine below it, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Render the missing metadata block for this card, or ensure the list item template always outputs title/rating/delivery info.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right screen edge and its name is hard-clipped to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, so content looks broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal padding/peek for the carousel and apply text truncation with an ellipsis so clipped titles read as intentional.

issues.description: The category chip row ('All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy…') is cut off mid-chip at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that it scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent partial chip peek or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling: one has a white circular background, the other a dark/transparent circle, reducing visibility on light imagery.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button background, size and icon colour across all cards, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.
